inozemtseva2014.citation: Inozemtseva, L., and Holmes, R. (2014). Coverage is not strongly correlated with test suite effectiveness. Proceedings of ICSE 2014, 435-445.
claims: With suite size controlled, the correlation between coverage and effectiveness was low to moderate; for Joda Time it was essentially zero.
inozemtseva2014.quote: should not be used as a quality target
inozemtseva2014.interval: Reported as Kendall tau correlations per program, not intervals.
inozemtseva2014.does_not_prove: That coverage is useless; the authors say it finds under-tested code. Effectiveness was measured with planted faults, in Java only.

just2014.citation: Just, R., Jalali, D., Inozemtseva, L., Ernst, M. D., Holmes, R., and Fraser, G. (2014). Are mutants a valid substitute for real faults in software testing? Proceedings of FSE 2014, 654-665.
claims: 73% of real faults were coupled to generated mutants; 17% were coupled to no mutant.
just2014.quote: statistically significant correlation between mutant detection and real fault detection
just2014.interval: None reported in the passages read.
just2014.does_not_prove: That a mutation score is a complete stand-in for real faults. Java programs only.

wang2025.citation: Wang, Y., et al. (2025). Are "Solved Issues" in SWE-bench Really Solved Correctly? An Empirical Study. arXiv:2503.15223.
claims: 7.8% of patches that passed the benchmark tests failed the developer-written tests; 29.6% behaved differently from the ground-truth patch.
wang2025.quote: call to arms for more robust and reliable evaluation of issue-solving tools
wang2025.does_not_prove: Anything about other benchmarks or tools. Part of its estimate rests on a 77-patch manual sample.

aleithan2024.n: n = 251 passing patches from one agent
aleithan2024.citation: Aleithan, R., et al. (2024). SWE-Bench+: Enhanced Coding Benchmark for LLMs. arXiv:2410.06992.
claims: Of 251 patches that passed all tests, 32.67% had the solution leaked in the task and 31.08% passed weak tests; the resolution rate fell from 12.47% to 3.97% after filtering.
aleithan2024.does_not_prove: That newer agents or other benchmark versions show the same rates. Labels are the authors' manual judgments.
